# Temple of Sun — the full site, in plain text

> Holistic wellness by Péter Frák: hand-blended aromatherapy formulas, one-to-one healing treatments, meditation classes and Soul Alchemy Retreats, practised between Portugal and Hungary. Every blend is made from 100% pure, laboratory-tested essential oils, composed in a meditative state.

This document is the complete content of https://templeofsun.com for language models and AI assistants.
A short index lives at https://templeofsun.com/llms.txt. Content last updated 2026-08-24.

## The business, in facts

- Name: Temple of Sun (written "templeofsun"). Slogan: Alchemy of souls.
- Founder and sole practitioner: Péter Frák, aromatherapist and holistic practitioner from Kecskemét, Hungary, practising between Portugal (Lisbon) and Hungary.
- Founded: 2020, with the Rainbow Collection.
- Offerings: aromatherapy blends (23 formulas, €29.50 to €40.60), bespoke custom formulas, one-to-one treatments, online sessions, meditation classes, Mindfulness LABs for venues, Soul Alchemy Retreats in Portugal, and scent design for spaces and brands.
- Credentials: certified aromatherapist (Panarom Budapest, 2-year diploma); member of the International Federation of Aromatherapists (IFA); Ayurvedic and Marma-Abhyanga massage therapist (Mysore Ayurveda Academy, India); Reiki practitioner; rebirthing breath-work facilitator.
- Collaborations: creator of the Jivamukti Essence, the official aroma oil of Jivamukti Yoga (2024); more than fifty retreats supported at Vale de Moses, Portugal; practice held at Quinta da Comporta and JNcQUOI.
- Independent reviews: 29 five-star guest reviews on BookRetreats (https://bookretreats.com/organizers/o/peter-frak).
- Languages: English, Hungarian, German.
- Contact: templeofsunofficial@gmail.com · WhatsApp +36 70 287 9225 · https://templeofsun.com/contact.html
- Social: Instagram https://www.instagram.com/templeofsun/ · TikTok https://www.tiktok.com/@templeofsun · Facebook https://www.facebook.com/templeofsunalchemy · Spotify and Telegram links on the site.
- Aromatherapy at Temple of Sun is a complementary practice; it does not replace medical care.

## Aromatherapy, an introduction
URL: https://templeofsun.com/aromatherapy.html

Aromatherapy · Introduction

### Scent as medicine

what it is, and how it works

What it is

### A therapy as old as gardens

Aromatherapy is a holistic, immune-supporting complementary therapy. It aids the body's own self-healing, softens anxiety and stress, and works on body, mind and the subtle level at once.

It uses essential oils: highly concentrated aromatic essences extracted from plants, flowers and trees. Because each drop is so concentrated, oils are almost always diluted before use and handled with care. Aesthetic use, the pleasant oils in creams and lotions, is only one small facet; whole-person, holistic aromatherapy is the heart of it.

By Péter Frák, Certified Aromatherapist · IFA member · practising hands-on with essential oils for more than a decade. Updated August 2026 .

A short history

### From temple smoke to laboratory

Antiquity

#### The first apothecaries

Chinese, Egyptian, Greek, Roman and Native American cultures used aromatic oils for therapy, hygiene and ritual.

1st century

#### Dioscorides writes it down

Essential oils enter De Materia Medica, the great herbal of the ancient world.

11th century

#### Avicenna's stills

Steam-distilled oils are used as medicine across the Islamic golden age.

1937

#### Gattefossé's burn

The French chemist René-Maurice Gattefossé burns his hand in his laboratory, plunges it into lavender oil, watches it heal, and gives “aromathérapie” its name.

1940s

#### Valnet at the front

The surgeon Jean Valnet uses essential oils to disinfect soldiers' wounds in the Second World War.

How it works

### Three ways scent reaches you

01 · The breath

#### Inhalation

Vapours are absorbed through the rich blood supply of the lungs and travel the body for hours.

02 · The skin

#### Touch & massage

During massage, the diluted blend passes through the pores into the bloodstream; warmth and touch carry it deeper.

03 · The mind

#### Memory & emotion

Scent travels the olfactory nerve straight to the limbic system. Lavender invites serotonin and calm; rosemary wakes you; jasmine opens the heart.

Subtle aromatherapy

### What each part of the plant gives

In the subtle reading, the part of the plant an oil comes from shapes the gift it carries.

#### Flower

reaches the heart and soul, helping it blossom

#### Leaf

supports the breath, and moments that need one

#### Root

grounding, digestion, a way back to your roots

#### Resin

protects and heals, as resin covers a wound

#### Fruit

joy, the inner child, self-confidence

#### Seed

latent power, for numbness or stuckness

#### Bark

an energetic hug around the soul, like cinnamon

#### Wood

quiet strength and steadiness, like sandalwood's calm

Choosing well

### What quality looks like

A true essential oil is labelled pure essential oil , not “aromatherapy oil”, which is usually stretched with cheaper carriers. Real rose, jasmine and neroli are costly to extract; a very cheap bottle is telling you something. Good oils come in dark glass, away from light, and base oils are best cold-pressed and virgin.

Kept dark, cool and closed, most oils live about two years; citrus about one; thick tree oils up to five. Patchouli and myrrh only get better with age.

Ritual

### How to use the blends

#### In the diffuser

8–12 drops in your room, or during yoga and meditation. Let the space carry the work.

#### In your palms

1–2 drops, rub together, inhale deeply five times, mornings and evenings. After three weeks, rest for one.

#### On the skin

Dilute ~3 drops in a little cold-pressed base oil and massage in. Five days on, two days off.

Essential oils are highly concentrated: dilute before use, keep away from children and eyes, and take extra care in pregnancy. Never exceed a 2.5% dilution without professional guidance, and never take oils by mouth without qualified medical supervision. These blends support wellbeing; they do not replace medical care.

## The Rainbow Collection

### The Rainbow Collection

eighteen blends, made around feelings

← Both collections
Collection One · The story

### Born under Indian stars

The Rainbow Collection was born in 2020, after a mind-bending 12-hour New Year's Eve ceremony in a hidden ashram in India.

The night was pure devotion: Bhajans, Kirtans, 108 rounds of the Hanuman Chalisa, Yoga Nidra, Havan, meditations. Wave after wave of energy. By the end, I was overflowing with Prana, awake for 36 hours, high on life itself.

On the morning of January 1st, I followed an inner pull to the ocean. For ten days, I sat on the beach for hours each day, channeling the Rainbow formulas: receiving downloads of wisdom, flashes from past lives, streams of inspiration. It felt surreal, as if something ancient was moving through me.

When COVID began, I returned to the yoga retreat in the Portuguese mountains where I lived. The rest of that year became a time of quiet alchemy: refining the blends, exploring their synergy, scent, and energy, and testing them with the souls around me.

During this time, my dear friend @zhenyaland offered to bring the Rainbow magic to life: designing the website, logo, and labels, and shaping the visual soul of templeofsun. Since then, she's been the co-parent of this creation, the unseen co-weaver of its beauty. Forever grateful for your love, support, and creative light.

## The 5 Elements
URL: https://templeofsun.com/5-elements.html

Aromatherapy · Collections

### The 5 Elements

the Panchamahabhuta, bottled

← Both collections
Collection Two · The story

### Five elements, one balance

All living and non-living matter in the universe is made up of five fundamental elements that are called Panchamahabhuta.

The five great elements in Ayurveda are ether/space (Akasha), air (Vayu), fire (Agni), water (Jala), and earth (Prithvi). Ayurveda focuses on bringing these five elements into balance, both internally and externally, to bring about superior health.

Ayurveda believes disease (or dis-ease in the body) starts with an emotional response followed by physical symptoms. For that reason, the primary focus is looking at root causes over just treating outward symptoms. The root cause comes down to the elements that exist within us and identifying how they are out of balance.

In the body, each element is associated with different tissues and functions. In the mind, the elements are also associated with personality characteristics and emotional responses.

The following 5 elements holistic formulas are meant to harmonize the excess or deficiency of the elements within ourselves. You can use an element formula to balance either the abundance or deficiency of a given element.

The map within

Ether at the throat, Air at the heart, Fire at the solar plexus, Water at the sacral centre, Earth at the root. Touch one, and I will introduce you.

## Create Your Own Formula
URL: https://templeofsun.com/create-your-own-formula.html

Aromatherapy · Bespoke

### Create Your Own Formula

a signature scent for your space

The idea · in Peter's words

### Scent is memory

“I'm beyond excited about our collaboration: creating your personalised alchemy formula, for you to spread the magic of aromatherapy within your circle.

Your blend will naturally carry your intentions, your view of life, your philosophy and your love, everything you already give to the people in your space.

Diffuse it around your people, and the scent does quiet work: your students, guests and clients feel safe and at ease, the day's experience integrates more deeply, and every breath offers a sense of belonging.

And because smell is wired to memory, one breath of it at home brings back the feeling of your class, your retreat, your café. An invisible bond that slowly grows into community, and brings your people back to you.”

with love, Peter

The process

### How it works

01 · Presence

#### We tune in

A conversation about your space, your people and the feeling you want to hold: calm, welcome, focus, celebration.

02 · Alchemy

#### Blended with intention

Peter composes your formula from 100% pure, laboratory-tested oils, blended, bottled and blessed in a meditative state.

03 · Ritual

#### Your scent, your ritual

You receive your signature formula to diffuse and share, with guidance on how to weave it into your space and moments.

Who it's for

### Spaces that hold people

Yoga teachers and space holders. Therapists and healers. Boutique hotels, retreat venues, cafés and studios. Anyone whose work is a feeling, and who wants that feeling remembered.

Beneath the beauty sits real plant power: aromatherapy is a highly concentrated, complementary practice that offers deep emotional support and helps people tend to themselves on every level. Body, mind and soul.

## The Jivamukti Collaboration
URL: https://templeofsun.com/jivamukti-collaboration.html

Featured collaboration · Jivamukti Yoga

### The Jivamukti Essence

a scent born on Crete

← Create your own formula
Crete · February 2022

### It began with a treatment

“I didn't know what to expect. I've never been in Greece before, I didn't know anything about Jivamukti either, but I just knew I had to go.”

In February 2022 I had the opportunity to join the Jivamukti ashram on the magical island of Crete. At that time I was already hungry for traveling and for having the chance of living in a community and in nature again.

Days were passing by, and I started to adapt myself to their rhythm and practices. Eventually I got to know all the team members, guests and teachers. Some of them had already been there for three months by the time I arrived, and yet welcomed me with such openness and kindness. In just a few days I was already feeling like I'm home and we all are a little family living in paradise during such chaotic times.

Most of the team had been working, volunteering, offering their help tirelessly. I had just learned a new massage technique and was developing my Anahata treatment, so I thought of offering a free treatment to the team, so they could also receive, since they give so much. I transformed one of the rooms into a pop-up therapy room, created a little altar, and began the treatments.

Emma Henry from London arrived during my first week in Triopetra to teach us her incredible yoga classes. She was the first person I offered my Anahata: a heart-opening holistic aromatherapy facial treatment.

Days and weeks were passing by and we were all so free, present and full of love. Our inner children were free to play and experience the joy of life again. It was just wonderful to feel once more the power of community, nature, holistic practices, aromatherapy and kindness, in an ashram where people are so open and vulnerable.

During the last week, Camilla Veen and Moritz Ulrich arrived to teach us and bless us with their angelic energy and immense knowledge. I offered them the Anahata treatment as well, of course, and they ended up booking a second session during their week.

The seed of the collaboration was planted by the angels during the second treatment with Camilla. We both felt like floating in the state of Samadhi, experiencing Ananda-bliss during the treatment.

I didn't necessarily know consciously what would come out of the whole experience, but I just felt it was the beginning of something more important and meaningful. Months passed and we all returned home to our normal lives, still carrying the high vibrations we created in togetherness.

A year later, when I finally got the clarity about the seed we planted, I sent a video message to Camilla explaining my idea of the Jivamukti x templeofsun aromatherapy collaboration. Her response was just as wonderful, kind and supporting as she is by nature.

“There's nothing to fear. Your bare, naked existence is pure love. You are fierce, radiant, powerful, but most importantly a compassionate light being.”

The teaching that guided the alchemy

The formula

### Twelve oils, one heart

fruity and spicy, earthy but ethereal

When I designed the formula I worked with Jivamukti's own words and translated them to the language of Mother Nature:

radical wild activism true colourful fun avant-garde ethical compassionate liberation devotion love transformation unity

This alchemy process was beyond exciting, and the result is simply unexpected, surprising and mind-blowing to me. In the final recipe, twelve essential oils are blended together, representing the journey and philosophy of Jivamukti Yoga. I'm so proud of this formula and so grateful to share it. But mostly, I'm so excited for your journey with it.

The blend is light blue-green, representing Anahata, the centre of compassion, and it carries Shiva-consciousness energy: Lord Shiva's teachings gave me the main directions within the alchemy. There are sacred plants in the formula, giving you energetic protection as well.

What it awakens

### Life is forever changing, so are you

and that is not just okay; it is inevitable and exciting

When you receive your formula, trust me, it will demand your attention. Sit down, add one or two drops into your palms, close your eyes, and start inhaling slowly and rhythmically, five to seven times. Just observe what it shows you, where it guides you, what it reveals about you that day.

The Jiva Essence will boost your internal processes and give you a kick whenever you feel stuck. It will support you gently when you are in your letting-go process, open up your playful side by reconnecting you with your inner child, or simply reassure you: yes, you got this. You have that raw power within you that enables you to stand tall and stable even in the wildest storms.

And when the storm hits you, it will also remind you that you are not alone. Yoga is about community, and life is so much better shared with others. Mother Nature always represents this aspect so well. There is a lot of movement happening energetically within the formula, and so there will be in you. The flowers in it will protect your heart and let you know that you are loved. Not in a romantic way; wildly.

While designing the Jiva Essence I worked a lot with the Chakra system: the twelve ingredients were chosen to touch and boost the entire energy body, kicking the engines in via Ajna, the third-eye centre.

Two ways to carry it

### Bottle or roll-on

Pure essential oil · 10ml

#### The concentrated blend

Highly concentrated, laboratory-tested essential oils; the highest quality you can get. Add one or two drops into your hands, mornings and evenings, rub your palms together and inhale the scent five to seven times, deeply and rhythmically, and let it guide you. Do the same right before meditation or yoga practice; teachers can offer it during savasana.

For your space, yoga studio or working environment: 8 to 12 drops in an aroma diffuser. Do not diffuse around children under 6 or people with sensitivity towards epilepsy.

Their shop · bottle

Roll-on · 10ml

#### The natural perfume

A subtle, less concentrated version of the mother blend, diluted with the golden queen of skin care: bio jojoba base oil, safe even on thin and sensitive skin. The ingredients are the same, but the alchemy follows botanical perfumery, so it functions as an ethereal, high-vibrational natural perfume. Roll it onto your pulse points, neck, wrists, the inner side of your ankles, and onto your heart.

Feel free to apply it onto your Chakra centres: work daily or weekly with different Chakras and observe what it reveals about your inner temple.

Their shop · roll-on

The ingredients are known to aid digestion, and using the blend regularly will help you digest life's every aspect. The oils also carry uplifting, harmonising qualities, and some of the plants are believed to boost circulation and support the heart and your emotional processes.

With care: never take any of the formulas internally. Do not use during pregnancy or in case of epilepsy. When using on the skin, do a sensitising test first with one drop on your wrist. The blend is phototoxic: keep treated skin out of direct sun and UV light for 8 hours. Use daily for three weeks, then keep one week of integration and clearing before restarting. Questions are always welcome; write to Peter.

## Treatments
URL: https://templeofsun.com/treatments.html

Experiences · One on one

### Treatments

the art of loving touch

Therapies · treatments · healing

### First, I tune in to you

Every treatment starts the same way: not with a menu, but with a moment of listening.

Before we begin, I tune in to who is in front of me. I ask what you need in that moment, and only then do I gather the aromas for your journey. No two sessions are the same, because no two people, and no two days, are. My guests describe feeling safe and seen , then leaving energized and grounded , often with a custom blend to carry the work home.

Signature · 90 minutes

### Anahata

mind bending, heart opening holistic therapy

I created Anahata during the pandemic, when hopelessness and separation felt sharpest, when so many of us lost touch with our heart space. This is my answer: a treatment built to reconnect you with your heart, support emotional healing, and let held grief and sadness finally move.

It is a multidimensional, multisensory experience that is difficult to fully explain; the mind struggles to grasp the depth of the process. Through personalised aromatherapy formulas, guided meditation, sound healing, multidimensional energy work, the power of loving touch, prayers and angel cards, we tend inner-child wounds, balance the chakra system, and plant energetic seeds for change.

Ayurvedic · 60 or 80 minutes

### Marma-Abhyanga

Ayurvedic full body anointing massage therapy

A rhythmic application of warm herbal oils to the skin, muscles and connective tissues, with focused stimulation of the Marma points, vital energy centres throughout the body. Ayurvedic tradition holds that regular practice enhances the flow of prana, improves circulation, strengthens resilience to stress, supports immune function, calms the nervous system, relieves tension and improves sleep.

My version blends the tradition with lymphatic and deep-tissue technique and my own art of loving touch, on a regular massage bed rather than the traditional wooden table. I choose your oils from my aromatherapy-alchemy studies, personalised to your constitution: a sacred journey of rejuvenation, relaxation and reconnection to the self.

Both journeys

## Soul Alchemy Retreats
URL: https://templeofsun.com/retreats.html

Experiences

### Soul Alchemy Retreats

reconnect with your true essence

The journey

### Seven days to come home to yourself

A Soul Alchemy Retreat is a six-night, seven-day holistic journey in a private Portuguese quinta, built on love, playfulness, authenticity and vulnerability.

The days weave together mindfulness and guided meditation, yoga and Qi-Gong, aromatherapy, massage, sound healing, soul-nourishing ritual and honest rest. Plant-based meals. Small circles. Nature all around. A safe space to explore, release and realign.

Peter's retreats grow from four seasons living and working at Vale de Moses, one of Europe's most loved yoga retreats in the Portuguese mountains, where he supported more than fifty retreats and massaged hundreds of guests before beginning to host his own.

The rhythm

### A day at the retreat

Each edition carries its own theme (past journeys have followed the five elements, and the search for dharma) but the days share one gentle rhythm:

7:15 Tibetan Pranayama & meditation
8:30 Hatha Yoga & Qi-Gong
10:00 Plant-based breakfast
11:00 Free time, pool & 1-on-1 treatments
17:00 Transformational holistic workshop
19:30 Dinner, music, sharing, laughter
21:00 Evening meditation

## Online Sessions
URL: https://templeofsun.com/online-sessions.html

Online Sessions · one to one, at any distance

### Online healing

healing, at any distance

In my own words

### The work travels well

Changing one's lifestyle, behaviours and old counterproductive habits is necessary in this process. It's never easy; sometimes it is even unpleasant for a short time.

I'm here to support your journey with all my knowledge and compassion for all humankind, together with the healing power that aromatherapy offers. These online sessions are for anyone who wants to improve their wellbeing, rediscover their true self, or simply needs guidance toward healthier directions, within themselves and their environment. Everything you share is held in complete confidentiality.

One hour · One time · Online

### Holistic Health Consultation

receive personalised guidance designed to restore harmony from within

In our 60-minute session I guide you through a health and lifestyle questionnaire to explore your unique needs. Together we look at your current challenges, habitual patterns, areas of imbalance, your lifestyle and daily routines.

Based on your elemental and Doshic constitution, I offer practical recommendations (new directions, foods, habits and tools) that support your everyday harmony and wellbeing. We also discuss your health history, emotional landscape and mental patterns, and from this holistic picture I create personalised aromatherapy suggestions to assist you.

If you wish, ongoing aromatherapy support continues afterwards, wherever you live.

Three months · Six sessions + intro call · Online

### Spiritual Mentoring & Transformation

reconnect with your authentic self through aromatherapy, empathy and presence

A transformative three-month, one-on-one journey for personal growth, healing and alignment. We meet online twice a month for 60 minutes (six sessions plus an introduction call) and you receive three + one templeofsun aromatherapy formulas of 5ml each, specially created for your needs and the themes we explore. Each month you work with one formula daily; the additional blend supports your integration at the end.

Over more than a decade I have witnessed the profound healing power of aromatherapy, and how it opens pathways toward balance. Combined with mindful mentoring and active listening, it can catalyse life-changing shifts. Along the way you also receive personalised meditation practices, reflective exercises and holistic tools that nurture the specific parts of your health and life we are tending.

“I understand how intimate and personal this kind of work is. I approach every session with empathy, presence, and dedication. Throughout our time together, I will be fully here for you: offering a safe, supportive, and nurturing space for your transformation to unfold.”

One week · 40 minutes daily · Online

### Meditation Guidance

rediscover clarity, balance, and inner peace through personalised practice

Do you often feel mentally or emotionally exhausted? Do you find it difficult to build, or return to, a consistent meditation practice? Are you longing for guidance to help you meditate with ease and confidence?

If so, this one-on-one program is for you. For one week we meet online, 40 minutes a day. I personally guide you through foundational meditation techniques rooted in Tibetan Buddhist practice, complemented by Pranayama breathing exercises. Each session adapts to your current level and needs, so your routine feels natural and sustainable, built without pressure or disappointment.

Through the week you explore different approaches and feel their effects on body, mind and emotions, developing the confidence and connection with inner stillness that makes you genuinely look forward to your practice.

“It would be my pleasure and honour to share the insights, tools, and practices that have supported me along the way, so that you, too, can cultivate peace, focus, and inner balance in your everyday life.”

## Meditation Classes
URL: https://templeofsun.com/meditation.html

Experiences · Practice

### Meditation Classes

clarity, balance, inner peace

The path · in my own words

### A practice grown over decades

Meditation has been part of my life since childhood. In the beginning, it served as a coping mechanism, an escape into the spiritual world.

My first formal experience came during my initial Reiki training at age fifteen, and from that point onward, meditation gradually evolved into a practice of acceptance, awareness, and inner spaciousness.

Over the past decade I have studied and practised Vipassana in both the Goenka and Mahasi traditions, along with Tibetan Buddhist pranayama and meditation at dedicated centres, deepened by a two-year journey through India and Southeast Asia. What I teach is what I practise.

Two ways to sit

## Mindfulness LABs

Experiences · In circle

### Mindfulness LABs

alchemical journeys, taken together

What a LAB is · in my own words

### A living workshop

Over the years, I have developed a series of holistic workshops that I lovingly call “Meditation LABs.” These immersive experiences bring together a rich blend of tools and techniques I have worked with for many years, carefully designed to support collective transformation and inner exploration within a group setting.

Aromatherapy alchemy, pranayama breathwork, Kriya and guided meditation, chanting, journaling, chakra exercises, sound healing, visualisation and oracle readings: each concept fluid by design, evolving with the astrological energies and the dynamics of the group, so no two are ever the same.

These workshops are an invitation to experiment, to awaken the senses, and to reconnect with the sacred space within, where transformation begins.

Signature journeys

### The four LABs

Heart

#### Anahata LAB

Spiritual heart alchemy: opening and tending the heart space, where grief softens and warmth returns.

Return

#### Homecoming LAB

“I'm busy; I'm meeting myself.” A Yoga Nidra journey back to the one person you keep postponing.

Tenderness

#### Inner Child Care LAB

Gentle, guided work with the youngest parts of you: play, safety and long-overdue kindness.

Balance

#### 5 Elements LAB

Earth, water, fire, air and ether: exploring your elemental constitution through practice, scent and ritual.

Custom LAB concepts are also designed for retreats, collaborations and special gatherings, tailored to the theme, intention and energy of the invitation.

For venues & events

### Classes for your guests

For hotels, resorts and beach clubs, the LABs distil into a menu of 50-minute group classes: small circles of up to twelve, held in a calm space, no experience needed:

- Yoga Nidra guided “yogic sleep”: conscious deep rest for the nervous system

- Meditation Vipassana and mindfulness tools for stillness and clarity

- Sound Healing Tibetan bowls, voice and vibration, felt at a cellular level

- Pranayama ancient breath science to regulate, restore and enliven

- Aromatherapy Workshop an experiential journey into essential oils and their gifts

## Bio: Péter Frák
URL: https://templeofsun.com/bio.html

About · Bio

### This is me.

My name is Péter Frák, also known as templeofsun. I am a holistic healer and soul alchemist with a rich and diverse background in spiritual and esoteric practices.

As a certified aromatherapist, Ayurvedic massage therapist, multidimensional energy worker, and practitioner of breath-work and meditation, my approach to healing blends ancient wisdom with contemporary techniques.

Namaste, welcome.

“My life's mission is to bring love, light, and transformation to those in need.”

Péter Frák
The practices

Aromatherapy Ayurvedic Massage Energy Work Breath-work Vipassana Goenka & Mahasi Tibetan Pranayama Sound Healing Reiki

The path · in brief

### Two decades of dedication

Hungary · France · Sri Lanka · Bali · India · Portugal

My spiritual journey began at the age of fifteen, during a time when I struggled to find a sense of belonging. By chance I discovered a Reiki course, was initiated by my master, and began studying energy healing, aura reading and angel communication: the beginning of my exploration into the world of holistic healing.

Over the years I enriched my studies through transformative experiences in aromatic plant alchemy, massage therapy and Ayurveda across Sri Lanka, Bali and India. I earned my aromatherapy diploma in Hungary after two years of study and became a member of the International Federation of Aromatherapists in France. I trained as a rebirthing breath-work facilitator in Portugal, explored Vipassana in both the Goenka and Mahasi styles, and delved into traditional Tibetan Pranayama and meditation at a Buddhist centre.

Now, after two decades of dedication and personal growth, I integrate these diverse teachings into my own healing approach, and remain deeply committed to guiding and supporting souls on their path of healing.

Quiet proof

## My Story, in Péter's own words
URL: https://templeofsun.com/about.html

About · My story · in my own words

### A light that kept calling

I was fifteen when my spiritual path first lit up. One sunny afternoon, in the garden of my childhood home in Kecskemét, Hungary, a neighbour told me about Reiki. That initiation (energy healing, aura reading, angel communication) became my first true spark of self-love, and a world quietly opened.

Through my twenties, spirituality was my refuge. While I came to terms with who I was, while loneliness visited, life swept me into fashion: head booker for Hungary's leading model agency, then stylist, editor and model agent in Berlin. Seven years surrounded by beauty, and still, something essential was missing.

The courage to leave Hungary healed me in ways doctors couldn't explain. And then, in 2017, aromatherapy found me.

The path · continued

### From Budapest to the mountains of Portugal

Sri Lanka · Bali · Vietnam · the Philippines · Mysore · Portugal

During a course in Budapest, exhausted and searching, I wept in my teacher's arms, feeling embraced, seen and guided. After years of looking, I had finally arrived.

I left fashion. I studied and travelled through Asia (Sri Lanka, Bali, Vietnam, the Philippines): nine months of alchemy research and meditation, later deepened with Ayurvedic and Marma-Abhyanga training in Mysore, India, and Vipassana in both the Goenka and Mahasi traditions, with Tibetan Pranayama at a Buddhist centre. Then I settled as a therapist in the mountains of Portugal, where four seasons at the renowned Vale de Moses retreat taught me what fifty retreats and hundreds of bodies can teach a pair of hands.

Today I live between Portugal and Hungary: holding space at Quinta da Comporta and JNcQUOI, hosting the Soul Alchemy Retreats, and blending the templeofsun formulas, each one made in a meditative state, with prayer. I return to Asia every year to learn, recharge and deepen my connection to the Divine.

I hold my early illnesses, struggles and heartbreaks as gifts: they taught me compassion, strength and purpose. One day they will grow into healing centres of my own. That is the dream I am walking toward, one treatment, one blend, one retreat at a time.

with love, Peter aka templeofsun

## Philosophy
URL: https://templeofsun.com/philosophy.html

About

### Philosophy

how healing happens here

“A healer does not heal you. A healer is someone who holds space for you while you awaken your inner healer, so that you may heal yourself.”

Maryam Hasnaa

In my own words · Belief one
01

### Heal from the roots, not the surface

By Péter Frák · updated August 2026

Through the course of my holistic studies, as well as through the illnesses I've experienced in my life, it's become abundantly clear to me that all bodily disharmonies need to be examined and treated not just on the physical, but also on the emotional, energetic and psychic levels. I strongly believe taking a pill will not eliminate a disease fully. Instead it is necessary to weed out an illness from its roots in the mind and soul, so it won't manifest in another form. Changing one's lifestyle, behaviours and old counterproductive habits is necessary in this process.

Our anomalies, weaknesses and physical imbalances should be searched for in our minds, digestive tracts and emotional worlds all at the same time. And in every case we have to examine the extraordinary connection between our nervous and digestive systems, while diving deep into the dimensions of our souls.

“All disease begins in the gut.” Hippocrates

Belief two
02

### Every person is unique

During my twenties I tried a lot of different holistic methods and visited a wide range of therapists. I learned from this journey that not every holistic healing method will help each individual the same way it may help others. We are all unique creatures, and as such, the healing process should also be uniquely personalised to each person's needs.

Moreover, as the seasons change during the year, so do we constantly change in our lives. It is quite possible that a method that did not work before may prove beneficial under new circumstances.

It is never a certain bet that one person will benefit from the same diet, massage or medicine that has helped another heal, as our physical and mental constitutions are each so different. Complete examination is, thus, always a must.

Belief three
03

### Presence over certificates

I believe the greatness of a therapist lies not in certificates hanging on a wall, but in the fact that as soon as the patient sits down, the therapist is present, is interested, reads between the lines, connects with the person, is open-minded, is humble, and ultimately radiates peace. I believe a successful therapist is one that listens carefully, willing to look at each person's case from different perspectives with an open heart and a bright mind.

Belief four
04

### Symptoms are teachers

I believe all diseases and physical symptoms are teachings. They teach us to become more self-aware, and encourage us to pay attention to ourselves, to care for our precious bodies. The body-mind is sophisticated and intelligent enough to send us warning signals in case of imbalance. But to be able to read those signs requires mindfulness and awareness. Holistic techniques provide a broad spectrum of solutions to maintain health and harmony, so we can prevent unnecessary aggravation of disease.

The Dalai Lama, asked what surprised him most about humanity

“Man. Because he sacrifices his health in order to make money. Then he sacrifices money to recuperate his health. And then he is so anxious about the future that he does not enjoy the present; the result being that he does not live in the present or the future; he lives as if he is never going to die, and then dies having never really lived.”

Belief five
05

### The healing power of loving touch

A proper diet, daily exercise, self-care, good sleep, prayer, meditation, a healthy intimate life, and reconnection to Mother Nature are all necessary to one's good health. But to take it further, I believe nowadays it is ever more important to recognise the healing power of a loving touch. We are losing the connection to one another. We humans are social creatures, and therefore we naturally need a daily dose of loving, supportive hugs: gentle, caring touches.

Being able to use the vibration of love is the most precious healing tool I feel I have received from the Universe. All of my experiences have proven to me that love is the greatest healer. It can move mountains in the soul, switch on the self-healing mechanism of the body, and clear all the dark clouds from the mind.

My goal is to make my patients feel valuable and loved through my treatments, as well as safe within the space that I hold for them. I truly seek for them to explore all the magic that exists within them.

I wish you a beautiful healing journey.

Péter Frák

The enemy is disconnection

“Nature is our Mother. Because we live cut off from her, we become sick.”

Thich Nhat Hanh

Experience it in person

## Every blend of The Rainbow Collection, in detail

### Focus (10ml, €33.20)
URL: https://templeofsun.com/rainbow-collection.html#focus
For: concentration, study and clear thought

The synergistic blend of sage, peppermint and lavender is traditionally used to support concentration, memory and the process of studying. This blend is recommended during periods of intense mental provocation, when your brain is taking in large amounts of information without much time to rest and process, for example, when it feels difficult to concentrate, especially during deadlines or exams. Inhaling this blend may support a harmonious, focused state of mind. It is your perfect study-mate for creating projects, preparing for exams, meeting deadlines at work, and generally combating all forms of distraction that impede productivity.

Ritual · how to use

Add 8-10 drops into your diffuser while studying, working or creating projects. Add 2 drops into your palms, rub them together and inhale the scent 7 times deeply and rhythmically when loosing focus. After 3 weeks of continuous use keep 1 week break.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Copaifera officinalis (copaiba balm), Mentha piperita (peppermint), Salvia officinalis (sage), Lavandula angustifolia (English lavender), Rosmarinus officinalis ct. cineole (rosemary) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

I've taken a lot of exams, when I'm getting tired or my thoughts are blocked, I have a sniff straight from the vial and my mind and thoughts get stabilized immediately. Basically your best friend in any situation where Focus is required.

★★★★★

“I recently started a Masters study alongside my work, and with everything going on I felt like I was easily losing focus and thinking of too many things at once. I don't like drinking coffee, so this is a fantastic alternative to energise me and keep me focused on my studies and work. I like to rub it in my palms and inhale a few times as suggested, but sometimes I also just smell from the bottle and it already makes me feel more awake and focused. Thank you Peter for this magical blend!”
Aisha
Please read · cautions

For external use only. Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes. In case of epilepsy handle with care. If pregnant, lactating, taking medication or under doctor's care consult a physician prior to use. Store at room temperature, away from sunlight. A skin test is recommended prior to use. Do not use long term and in large quantities.

Guest review by Aisha: "I recently started a Masters study alongside my work, and with everything going on I felt like I was easily losing focus and thinking of too many things at once. I don't like drinking coffee, so this is a fantastic alternative to energise me and keep me focused on my studies and work. I like to rub it in my palms and inhale a few times as suggested, but sometimes I also just smell from the bottle and it already makes me feel more awake and focused. Thank you Peter for this magical blend!"

### Homecoming (5ml, €32.00)
URL: https://templeofsun.com/rainbow-collection.html#homecoming
For: feeling lost, grounding, clarity

Do you sometimes feel lost in a situation, incapable of making decisions? Do you sometimes feel helpless, incapable of accessing your inner source? The incredibly complex Homecoming blend contains both vetiver to help you rediscover your inner strength and Atlas cedar to guide you back to your inner peace. Other ingredients kickstart and clear stagnant internal processes. The incorporation of sage additionally awakens your intuition, fostering the ability to see with greater clarity during foggy times.

When I designed the recipe of the Homecoming blend, an especially personal one for me, one question was stirring in my mind: if I could travel back in time, what kind of aromatherapy blend would I have given to my own lost, sad, puzzled self, so I could have seen in myself at the time and in the world at large the embedded wonders that they truly contain?

Ritual · how to use

Mornings & evenings apply 2 drops into your palms, rub them together and inhale the scent slowly, deeply and rhythmically 7 times. After 5 days of use, keep 2 days of break.

Prior a challenging day, massage 3 drops into Manipura, the Solar plexus (the area above the belly button). It can help to remain strong-minded.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Cedrus atlantica (cedarwood), Ocimum basilicum (basil), Eucalyptus staigeriana (Brazilian eucalyptus), Pelargonium x asperum (rose geranium), Pogostemon cablin (patchouli) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

I recommend the olfactory (inhalation) therapy prior any type of meditation or mindfulness practice. Let this blend be a reminder to all: you are not the clouds, but the clear blue sky.

★★★★★

“Peter advised me to use this blend during a retreat last July, in the middle of the corona crisis, to get grounded, stay focused and come home to my own body and mind. I have used it ever since, first on the recommended basis (5 days use, 2 days break), but know I use it whenever I feel the need to feel more rooted, or just for the wonderful scent to accompany me during my day. I love it.”
Stephanie Simons
Please read · cautions

For external use only. Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes. If pregnant, lactating, taking medication or under doctor's care consult a physician prior to use. Store at room temperature, away from sunlight. Possible photosensitivity: avoid sun/UV light for 8-12 hours.

Guest review by Stephanie Simons: "Peter advised me to use this blend during a retreat last July, in the middle of the corona crisis, to get grounded, stay focused and come home to my own body and mind. I have used it ever since, first on the recommended basis (5 days use, 2 days break), but know I use it whenever I feel the need to feel more rooted, or just for the wonderful scent to accompany me during my day. I love it."

### Moonlight (10ml, €29.50)
URL: https://templeofsun.com/rainbow-collection.html#moonlight
For: sleep, calm, restless nights

Its specific components like mandarin, lavender, and marjoram are well known relaxants in aromatherapy.

According to traditional Chinese medicine, our 12 main organs recharge themselves in a specific order during sleep. The Chinese organ clock shows which organ is recovering at what time and how their energy levels accordingly change along the different meridians. Harmonious sleep is one of the best and most important ways to maintain health in your life.

Let the body and the mind dive deep into a truly healing, restorative sleep, with the power of every hidden star in the moonlight behind you.

Ritual · how to use

A) Add 8-10 drops into the diffusor in your bedroom before going to sleep. Let it vaporize the harmonizing blend during the whole night. Also add 1-1 drops into your palms, rub them together and inhale the scent slowly, deeply and rhythmically.

B) Make your own SPA at home. Dilute 10-12 drops in 3tbs of sea salt, add it to your warm bath (if you don't have a bathtub make a foot bath, use only 6-8 drops of essential oils). Lit some candles, put on meditation music, have a calming tea, breath deeply and slowly, and let your whole body sink into your aromatic bath.

Inside the bottle

The life-giving energies of the different citrus fruits, from sweet orange to bergamot to grapefruit, are carried within this blend. They are said to vibrate at the highest frequencies of happiness. Citruses will lift you up from darkness, lead you towards the light, and help you to reconnect with your inner child. Harnessing the vast power of sunlight, these ingredients can be extremely uplifting, said to be both preventing stress resulting from hectic lifestyle and helping to deal with everyday stresses.

Ritual · how to use

For 28 days, mornings & evenings apply 2 drops into your palms, rub them together and inhale the scent slowly, deeply and rhythmically 7 times. Or you can add 2 drops mornings and evening onto the Solar Plexus (Manipura chakra) the area just above the belly button (avoid sun and UV light for 8 hours), rub it in and inhale the scent from your hands deeply and rhythmically. After 28 days of use, keep 1 week of break and then continue the healing journey.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Citrus bergamia zest (bergamot peel), Citrus limonum zest (lemon peel), Citrus paradisii zest (grapefruit peel), Cedrus atlantica (cedarwood), Cupressus sempervirens (Mediterranean cypress) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

Get as much sunlight as possible, but spend at least 5 minutes on the sun every day. During grey and dark winter-like days, add 10 drops into your aroma-diffuser and light up the space around you.

Please read · cautions

For external use only. Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes. If pregnant, lactating, taking medication or under doctor's care consult a physician prior to use. Store at room temperature, away from sunlight. Phototoxic: skin shouldn't be exposed to sunlight, solarium light and UV rays for at least 8-12 hours after application of the product.

### Shen Essence (5ml, €36.90)
URL: https://templeofsun.com/rainbow-collection.html#shen-essence
For: calm, emotional and mental balance

In Traditional Chinese Medicine, the Shen is one of the vital substances of the body. It is the most subtle and non-material type of Qi. Most authors translate the word Shen as "spirit"; I prefer to translate Shen of the Heart as "Mind", where our emotions are translated into thoughts, into energy. This blend may assist with aiding and stabilising this largely mental process. It is recommended in case you are feeling irritable, frustrated or tense or in case of any kind of emotional imbalance. It contains lemon balm oil that Paracelsus (a Swiss physician, an alchemist and a philosopher of the German Renaissance) called the elixir of life. According to Hungarian folk traditions, lemon verbena and Roman chamomile have the strongest calming effects on a labile mind. They may reduce feelings of loneliness, assist you dealing with childhood traumas, and help you to rise up from the most difficult of situations, not unlike how the chamomile plant can straighten itself after being trampled upon.

Ritual · how to use

A) In case of emotional disharmony, everyday stresses: apply 6 drops on your Solar plexus (your energy centre above your belly button) + massage 2-2 drops into your temples + inhale the rest of the scent from your palms 5x deeply and rhythmically, mornings and evenings. In case of a long term therapy keep 2 days of break after 5 days of use. After 3 month of use, keep 1 week of break.

B) To ensure the quality of your sleep: massage 6 drops into the Solar plexus area + massage 6-6 drops into the inner part of your ankles + inhale the scent from your palms 5x deeply and rhythmically every evening. In case of a long term therapy keep 2 days of break after 5 days of use. After 3 month of use, keep 1 week of break.

C) In case of olfactory (inhalation) therapy to support your emotional and mental well-being: apply 2-2 drops on your wrists, rub them together and inhale the scents 7x deeply, rhythmically, 3 times per day. In case of a long term therapy keep 2 days of break after 5 days of use. After 3 month of use, keep 2 weeks of break.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Melissa officinalis (lemon balm), Pinus ponderosa (Ponderosa pine), Chamaemelum nobile (Roman chamomile), Origanum majorana (marjoram), Lavandula angustifolia (English lavender) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

I suggest you say out loud, 3x mornings & evenings, for 28 days, the following mantra: "I am connected with the energy of Mother Earth. I am connected to my body. I'm balanced, stable and grounded."

Please read · cautions

For external use only. Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes. If pregnant, lactating, taking medication or under doctor's care consult a physician prior to use. Store at room temperature, away from sunlight.

## Every blend of The 5 Elements, in detail

### Earth · Prithvi (root chakra, €40.00)
URL: https://templeofsun.com/5-elements.html#earth-prithvi
For: grounding, presence, support

The Earth element is that season of late summer, or between seasons, which is all about our connection. When we think of earth, we think of our groundedness, our presence to what is. In balance, Earth is content, grounded, present and connected, and it is the foundation for the other elements. It is nourished, both in body, soul and mind, and we are calm and loving, and free, feeling able to support others. Out of balance, we instead become needy. When we are out of touch with our ever-present connectedness, we drop into the Earth element emotion of worry.

This formula helps balance an excess or deficiency of the characteristics associated with the earth element: physical; material; form; structure; the ability to manifest an idea; practical sense; building; determined; holding on; grounded; anchored; stable; cautious; careful; conservative; steady; consistent; slow but sure; stubborn; obstinate; rigid; obsessed.

Useful for those who have one or more of the following characteristics: - cannot get projects from the idea stage into manifestation - need stability and consistency in their lives - are not grounded, tend to live with their heads in the clouds - need to cultivate a greater consciousness of their physical senses - need to be able to listen to their gut reactions - need determination and the ability to stick to a project or process - have difficulty completing things - don't want to change - are impatient and rigid - act rashly or too quickly - need to develop common sense

The Earth element, known in Sanskrit as "Prithvi" is the fifth and final great element. It is the final element because it evolves out of all five elements and contains the essence of all. Earth represents the densification of all matter until it becomes solid. Prithvi by its quality is stable, heavy, dry, dense, hard and tangible. When you are feeling ungrounded and unearthed you may feel flighty, chaotic or stuck in your head. According to Ayurveda, Prithvi Mahabhuta provides structural framework for each body parts. It is responsible to make the body strong and steady. Earth element is connected to the sense of smell.

Ritual · how to use

A) Add 8-12 drops into your diffuser in your home or during yoga/meditation classes and enjoy the energy of the earth in your space. Yoga teachers may offer 1 drop to their students at the beginning of the class (for meditation for example, before Pranayama practices) or right before Shavasana to inhale it a few times deeply. B) Add 1-2 drops into your palms, mornings and evenings, rub them together and inhale the scent from your hands 5x deeply and rhythmically. After 3 weeks of usage, keep 1 week of break, after the break you can continue the journey the same way. C) Using it on specific body parts topically, like on the sole of the foot, tailbone (location of the 1st chakra) etc, please dilute 3 drops of Earth element formula with a small amount of base oil (for example: bio, cold pressed, virgin coconut oil, sunflower seed oil or almond oil) massage into the area mornings and evenings for 5 days. After 5 days of usage keep 2 days of break and continue with the same routine. After 3 weeks of usage, keep 1 week of break.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Vetiveria zizanoides (vetiver), Piper nigrum (black pepper seed), Pogostemon cablin (patchouli), Artemisia dracunculus (tarragon), Citrus paradisii zest (grapefruit peel) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

Chanting Lam (lum), the bija mantra of the first chakra (root chakra), strengthens the earth element in the body and mind. This element relates to stability and solidity, so we would chant this to enhance these qualities in our body or life. Chant this mantra at least 7 times daily or 108 times for better result when feeling unsure, unsteady or insecure.

Please read · cautions

For external use only. Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes. If pregnant, lactating, taking medication or under doctor's care consult a physician prior to use. Store at room temperature, away from sunlight. Possible photosensitivity (where applied): avoid sun/UV light for 8-12 hours after application of the product.

### Water · Jala (sacral chakra, €40.00)
URL: https://templeofsun.com/5-elements.html#water-jala
For: intuition, flow, feeling

The water element is related to our innate wisdom. When we were born we had an inner knowing, an intuition which guided us through life, that is still there in all of us, underneath our thinking that it isn't. We forget over time that we were born with this water energy, as we lose trust in the world and begin to fear things. The main destructive emotion of the water element is fear.

This formula helps balance an excess or deficiency of the characteristics associated with the water element: emotional; receptive; feelings; compassion; the unconscious or subconscious; intuitive; cleansing; dissolving; no shape of your own; communication through feelings; holding onto emotions; taking on feelings or emotions of others; strong ties with the past, confidence; self-awareness.

Useful for those who have one or more of the following characteristics: - fear their inner world - need to listen to their intuition - need to cultivate greater sensitivity to others - are uncomfortable with their feelings - hold onto their feelings, not allowing them to simply be felt and flow through - resent others and hold grudges - are depressed, possessive or moody - feel emotionally needy and clingy - are "psychic sponges" - withdraw into a private, fantasy world - have difficulty having emotional boundaries

The Water element, known in Sanskrit as "Jala", is the fourth great element and evolves from Ether or Space, Air and Fire because it contains all aspects of the other three elements. Jala represent fluidic matter and provide the body with basic nourishment, protection against dissolution, give motion and soothe pain and inflammation. It also acts as the driving force for the transportation of body fluids and nutrients in the body, as well as for the removal of body wastes just like sweat or urine out of the body. We as humans are made up of 70-75% water. It is the element that primarily protects our body and provides it with its most fundamental nourishment. Water is healing; it protects, nourishes, and binds the body together. By its qualities, water is cooling, hydrating, heavy, smooth, stagnant or inflow. It is the antidote to the symptoms that have the opposite of these qualities such as deep sensitivity, emotionally ungrounded, dehydrated, on-edge, low self-esteem or if your heart has become hardened.

Ritual · how to use

A) Add 8-12 drops into your diffuser in your home or during Yin yoga/meditation classes and enjoy the energy of the water in your space. Yoga teachers may offer 1 drop to their students at the beginning of the class (for meditation for example, before Pranayama practices) or right before Shavasana to inhale it a few times deeply. B) Add 1-2 drops into your palms, mornings and evenings, rub them together and inhale the scent from your hands 5x deeply and rhythmically. After 3 weeks of usage, keep 1 week of break, after the break you can continue the journey the same way. C) Using it on specific body parts topically, like on the lower back/kidneys, lower belly area (location of the 2nd chakra) etc, please dilute 3 drops of Water element formula with a small amount of base oil (for example: bio, cold pressed, virgin coconut oil, sunflower seed oil or almond oil) massage into the area mornings and evenings for 5 days. After 5 days of usage keep 2 days of break and continue with the same routine. After 3 weeks of usage, keep 1 week of break.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Salvia sclarea (clary sage), Citrus limonum zest (lemon peel), Cedrus atlantica (cedarwood), Lavandula angustifolia (English lavender), Cupressus sempervirens (Mediterranean cypress) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

The mantra Vam (vum), the bija mantra of the second chakra (sacral chakra), strengthens the water element. This element relates to our ability to flow smoothly from one event to the next and to nourish others and ourselves. Chant this mantra at least 7 times daily or 108 times for better result when feeling harried, scattered, or in need of kindness and compassion.

Please read · cautions

Do not use during pregnancy and nursing. Possible skin sensitivity when applied without base oil (test it before usage by applying 1 drop onto the wrists to see how your skin reacts). Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas. Do not use internally. Phototoxic: skin (where applied) shouldn't be exposed to sunlight, solarium light and UV rays for at least 8 hours after application of the product.

### Fire · Agni (solar plexus, €40.00)
URL: https://templeofsun.com/5-elements.html#fire-agni
For: energy, transformation, will

Ether provides fire the space to burn while air provides fire the capacity to burn. Hence, the third element is fire which evolves from ether and air. Just as the sun is the generator of energy for the earth, fire is the generator of energy for the body. Fire is the form of perception, light, and vision, so the eyes are considered to be the sense organ of fire. Fire represents light, heat, energy, metabolism, and the power of transformation. People with a strong fire element in their constitution have leadership qualities and are adventurous, brave, confident, motivated, energetic, and progressive. They are eager in pursuing goals and are full of youthful spirit.

This formula helps balance an excess or deficiency of the characteristics associated with the fire element: energy; action; transformation; enthusiasm; passion; will; motivation; conviction; the strength to survive; faith; open to direction from your higher power; knowing the source; spirit; burned out; intense; don't know when to stop.

Useful for those who have one or more of the following characteristics: - need to activate their will to take action - are so passionate that they "burn out" or tire those around them - need enthusiasm, passion and faith in their lives - are stuck in their lives or in a process and need to move on - dislike weakness in others, especially if it reflects their own weakness - are pessimistic and unmotivated - are afraid of transformation - need to find or express their individuality and their passion in life - demand too much of themselves and others - are too sharp or hotheaded - are demonstrative of emotion, but not necessarily with sensitivity

The Fire Element, known in Sanskrit as Agni, is essential for your health. Agni is the intelligent force of each cell, each tissue and every system within the physical body. When the digestive fire (Agni) is healthy, this impacts the positive wellbeing of the whole body. Metaphorically speaking, fire stands for intelligence, wit, clarity, truth, presence, and light. The element of fire lives in the physical body, keeping us "burning" and moving. This fire directs the release of hormones via the endocrine system and oversees the digestive, metabolic, and regulatory functions. Ayurveda identifies that Fire also resides in an even more subtle place: our minds. In our minds, fire provides clarity, illumination, and truth. This subtle aspect of fire is called Tejas in Ayurvedic philosophy, and it directs all mental, emotional, and spiritual activity, including the crucial mental actions of discernment and discipline. Fire is the element responsible for burning, clearing, cleansing, transforming and illuminating, but also for destruction, rage, power, impatience and recklessness.

Ritual · how to use

A) Add 8-12 drops into your diffuser in your home or during yoga/meditation classes and enjoy the energy of the fire in your space. Yoga teachers may offer 1 drop to their students at the beginning of the class (for meditation for example, before Pranayama practices) or right before Shavasana to inhale it a few times deeply. B) Add 1-2 drops into your palms, mornings and evenings, rub them together and inhale the scent from your hands 5x deeply and rhythmically. After 3 weeks of usage, keep 1 week of break, after the break you can continue the journey the same way. C) Using it on specific body parts topically, for example the stomach area (location of the 3rd chakra) etc, please dilute 3 drops of Fire element formula with a small amount of base oil (for example: bio, cold pressed, virgin coconut oil, sunflower seed oil or almond oil) massage into the area mornings and evenings for 5 days. After 5 days of usage keep 2 days of break and continue with the same routine. After 3 weeks of usage, keep 1 week of break.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Citrus sinensis zest (sweet orange peel), Piper nigrum (black pepper seed), Elettaria cardamomum (cardamom seed), Citrus bergamia zest (bergamot peel), Eugenia caryophyllus (clove bud) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

The mantra Ram (rum) is the bija mantra of the third chakra (Solar plexus) and relates to the fire element. This element represents our ability to digest what is in front of us literally and figuratively, and the transformation of our work on ourselves. Chanting this mantra strengthens our work and encourages us to burn through any obstacles that have arisen. Chant this mantra at least 7 times daily or 108 times for better result.

Please read · cautions

Do not use during pregnancy and nursing and in case of high blood pressure. Causes skin sensitivity when applied without base oil (possibly less irritating without base oil by adding into the palms). Keep out of reach of children. Avoid contact with eyes, inner ears, and sensitive areas. Do not use internally. Phototoxic: skin (where applied) shouldn't be exposed to sunlight, solarium light and UV rays for at least 8 hours after application of the product.

### Air · Vayu (heart chakra, €40.00)
URL: https://templeofsun.com/5-elements.html#air-vayu
For: breath, letting go, inspiration

The Air element is often also described as 'Metal' in TCM, and it is all about taking in and letting go, the part of the cycle associated with grief, but also with the death of all that we think we are, and the reconnection to our true, grounded, connected nature. This element almost ties together all of the elements in a beautiful reminder that all we desire to be, we already are, but we forget this as we move through the cycles of life. The Air element is all about inspiration; about taking an expansive breath! In balance, we can inhale and exhale fully, in trust that the next breath will naturally come, just as life intended. We trust the process of grief, learning from each experience and gaining wisdom, trusting in life's flow. It is the season of Autumn; change. The imbalanced emotion of Air/Metal is grief, and lack of trust in letting go.

This formula helps balance an excess or deficiency of the characteristics associated with the air (metal) element: intellectual; thinking; logic; aesthetics; ideas; inspiration; original; creative; vision; detached; impersonal; objective; unlimited by form; infinite possibilities; the seed of a new form; flighty; ungrounded; nervous.

Useful for those who have one or more of the following characteristics: - are highly intellectual individuals who need a lot of mental stimulation - are ungrounded and tend to live from their minds - tend to believe that their mind's assessment of life is more important than their imagination, intuition, gut feelings, physical sensations, or instincts - need to increase their ability to plan and organize things - feel that intellectual pursuits are pretentious - need to get in touch with their creative and original thinking - need detachment and objectivity - are flighty and superficial - need to have more freedom or fear that their freedom is limited - are dealing with great amounts of information at the same time - obsess over situations or thoughts

The Air Element, known in Sanskrit as Vayu, not only means air as a mixture of nitrogen, oxygen, carbon dioxide and other gases but also as a dimension of movement. It is the mobile part of the body. It is responsible for inhalation, exhalation, movements of different body fluids and movements of different body parts, for example opening and closing of the eye lids. Vayu Mahabhuta is connected to the sense of touch. Out of all of the 5 Ayurvedic Elements, Vayu is the most accessible and easiest element to gain some mastery of. Most yogic practices involve an element of breath work, called pranayama. Prana means life force in Sanskrit and is the most available to our existence every moment of the day. Without Air, we have no breath or ability to move through life. The impact of the air that we breathe is very immediate. Most people can't go without air for more than three-and-a-half to five minutes before causing serious damage or suffocation. The qualities of Air evoke movement, ease, lightness, speed but also unpredictability and flightiness.

Ritual · how to use

A) Add 8-12 drops into your diffuser in your home or during yoga/meditation classes and enjoy the energy of the air element in your space. Yoga teachers may offer 1 drop to their students at the beginning of the class (for meditation for example, before Pranayama practices) or right before Shavasana to inhale it a few times deeply. B) Add 1-2 drops into your palms, mornings and evenings, rub them together and inhale the scent from your hands 5x deeply and rhythmically. After 3 weeks of usage, keep 1 week of break, after the break you can continue the journey the same way. C) Using it on specific body parts topically, like on the chest (location of the 4th chakra), please dilute 3 drops of Air element formula with a small amount of base oil (for example: bio, cold pressed, virgin coconut oil, sunflower seed oil or almond oil) massage into the area mornings and evenings for 5 days. After 5 days of usage keep 2 days of break and continue with the same routine. After 3 weeks of usage, keep 1 week of break.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Eucalyptus globulus (Tasmanian eucalyptus), Pinus sylvestris (Scots pine), Tsuga canadensis (Eastern hemlock), Melaleuca quinquenervia ct. cinéole (niaouli), Rosmarinus officinalis ct. camphre (rosemary) … and other magical plants.

Peter's personal tip

When you're feeling lethargic, apathetic or indifferent, chanting this mantra at least 7 times daily or 108 times for better result, may be the catalyst for the mental shift that is necessary to regain your perspective and enthusiasm.

### Ether · Akasha (throat chakra, €40.00)
URL: https://templeofsun.com/5-elements.html#ether-akasha
For: spirit, space, the subtle

The Ether Element, known in Sanskrit as The Akasha Mahabhuta is considered to be the first and most subtle element. In Sanskrit, it translates to "all-enclosing, omnipresent or all-pervading." It permeates through the cosmos and is the omnipotent force for all life, sound, vibration and creation. It is the creative life force energy that gives drive and consciousness to existence. All the openings, passages, pathways and movements in our body are what correspond to the Akasha element. There is space within our ears so we can hear sound. There is space within our throat so we can swallow. There is space within our eyes so we can look at our environment. There is space between our joints so we can move, run, walk and dance. There is space within our hearts to keep the blood flowing. Akasha is more than just the absence of matter, it is the original form of existence to which everything, and everyone formed and to which everything, and everyone shall return to.

The element of spirit does not have the same arrangements of correspondences as the physical elements, since spirit is not physical. Various systems may associate planets, tools, and so forth to it, but such correspondences are far less standardized than those of the other four elements. The element of spirit goes by several names. The most common are spirit, ether or aether, and quintessence, which is Latin for "fifth element."

This formula helps balance an excess or deficiency of the characteristics associated with ether element: the quintessence; the pure and subtle essence of a substance; new beginnings; the energy state before physical manifestation; organic; organization; the ability to rise above chaos; the ability and desire to focus on the inner life.

Useful for those who have one or more of the following characteristics: - are morbidly intense - speak in a loud voice - are unable to let go of anger and resentment, or who fly into rage easily - experience panic and desperation - feel cut off from a Higher Power - are selfish - need to either create roots or pull up worthless ones - have control issues to heal - feel they are out of control - are overly controlling - are attached to their worldly desires

In Ayurveda, ether element, "Akasha" is responsible for making the body soft porous and light. Akasha Mahabhuta, the ether element is connected to the sense of hearing. All opening and spacious organs of the body are areas of the Akasha Mahabhuta, it provides space for the movement of different fluids and nutrients in the body.

Ritual · how to use

A) Add 8-12 drops into your diffuser in your home or during yoga/meditation classes and enjoy the ethereal space created by the Ether element formula. Yoga teachers may offer 1 drop to their students at the beginning or end of the class (for meditation for example, before Pranayama practices) or right before Shavasana to inhale it a few times deeply. B) Add 1-2 drops into your palms, mornings and evenings, rub them together and inhale the scent from your hands 5x deeply and rhythmically. After 3 weeks of usage, keep 1 week of break, after the break you can continue the journey the same way. C) Using it on specific body parts topically, where you feel tense or blocked, please dilute 3 drops of Ether element formula with a small amount of base oil (for example: bio, cold pressed, virgin coconut oil, sunflower seed oil or almond oil) massage into the area mornings and evenings for 5 days. After 5 days of usage keep 2 days of break and continue with the same routine. After 3 weeks of usage, keep 1 week of break.

Inside the bottle

100% pure & laboratory tested essential oils of: Cedrus atlantica (cedarwood), Cupressus sempervirens (Mediterranean cypress), Boswellia sacra (holy frankincense), Citrus aurantifolia zest (lime peel), Origanum majoranna (marjoram) … and other magical plants.

Chant this mantra at least 7 times daily or 108 times for better result when having difficulty communicating, being afraid to speak our truth or fearing our own thoughts and feelings.
