## Questions and answers
URL: https://templeofsun.com/faq.html

### What exactly is a templeofsun blend?

Each blend is a formula of pure essential oils that I compose and blend by hand, in small batches. Every formula is built around a feeling or a moment of life rather than around a single scent. On each blend's page you will find the exact plants inside it and the story of why they are together.

### How do I choose the right blend for me?

Start with the feeling, not the scent. Ask yourself what you need more of right now: sleep, focus, courage, grounding, letting go. The Find Your Blend questionnaire walks you there in a few gentle questions, or you can wander the Rainbow Collection and see which name calls you. Your first instinct is usually right.

### What is the Rainbow Collection?

Eighteen blends, each made around a feeling. The collection was born in 2020, after a twelve-hour New Year's Eve ceremony in an ashram in India, and took shape over a year of quiet refining in the Portuguese mountains. The signature Rainbow blend itself holds 74 essential oils in one bottle. The full story lives on the collection page .

### What are the 5 Elements formulas?

Ayurveda teaches that all matter is made of five elements, the Panchamahabhuta: earth, water, fire, air and ether. The 5 Elements collection is five holistic formulas, one for each element, made to balance an excess or a deficiency of that element within you. The page includes a map of the elements and chakras to guide you.

### How do you make sure the oils you use are genuinely pure?

I choose only oils labelled as pure essential oil, never the cheaper “aromatherapy oil” blends stretched with filler carriers. Real rose, jasmine and neroli are costly to extract, so a very cheap bottle is telling you something. I keep them in dark glass, away from light, and choose cold-pressed, virgin base oils. More on what quality looks like is on the aromatherapy page .

### Is there a ritual to how the blends are made?

Yes. Every templeofsun formula is composed in a meditative state, with prayer, rather than mixed like a product on a line. You can read more about the path behind the blends in my story .

### What is the Jivamukti Essence?

It is a twelve-oil formula I created for Jivamukti Yoga, born from Anahata treatments I gave their teachers on the island of Crete in February 2022. The blend is light blue-green, representing Anahata, the heart chakra, and comes as a concentrated essential oil or as a gentler roll-on natural perfume in jojoba base oil. It is sold directly through Jivamukti's own shops, not through templeofsun. The full story and safety notes (not for use during pregnancy or in case of epilepsy, and phototoxic, so keep treated skin out of the sun for 8 hours) are on the Jivamukti Collaboration page .

### How do I use a blend day to day?

Slowly, and with attention. Breathe the blend in for a few calm breaths, let it touch the skin where the pulse lives, and give the moment a little silence. The oils work best when they are part of a small ritual rather than a rushed habit. Each blend's page suggests its own ritual.

### Can essential oils go directly on my skin?

Never undiluted. Essential oils are concentrated plant power, and the rule I hold to is simple: dilute before skin, in a good carrier oil, staying at or under a 2.5 percent dilution unless a professional guides you otherwise. Each of my blends comes with its own ritual of use on its page. If your skin is sensitive, test a small patch on the inner forearm first and wait a day. Keep oils away from the eyes and from broken skin, and if anything feels wrong, stop and write to me.

### I am pregnant, or I have a health condition. Can I still use the oils?

Some plants are wonderful friends in pregnancy and some are better left for later, and the same is true for conditions like epilepsy, asthma or ongoing medication. Please tell me before you choose a blend or book a treatment, and I will guide you honestly, including telling you when the answer is no. Your safety always comes before a sale.

### Where can I buy the blends?

Write to me through the contact page or on WhatsApp and we arrange it personally. Selected blends are also part of my collaboration with Jivamukti Yoga centres .

### Can I send a blend as a gift?

Yes, and it is one of my favourite kinds of order. Tell me who it is for and what they are living through, and I will help you choose. Start from the contact page with the gift topic selected.

### What happens in a treatment with you?

Every treatment is one to one and shaped around what you arrive with that day. We begin by talking, I listen, and then I work with the oils that your state asks for. You can read about the forms this takes on the treatments page . Everything you share with me stays between us.

### How do online sessions work?

We meet on a video call, from wherever you are in the world. The distance matters less than people expect: the listening, the guidance and the practices travel well. Details and what to prepare are on the online sessions page , and booking starts from the contact page .

### What languages do you work in?

English, Hungarian and German.

### What are Mindfulness LABs?

Mindfulness LABs are the group version of my work: immersive workshops that weave together aromatherapy, breathwork, guided meditation, sound healing and ritual. There are four signature journeys, Anahata, Homecoming, Inner Child Care and the 5 Elements LAB, and for hotels, resorts and beach clubs I also offer them as 50-minute classes for small circles of up to twelve, no experience needed. See the Mindfulness LABs page for the full menu, or write to me to bring one to your space.

### Do you teach meditation classes?

Yes, in two forms. Every Wednesday I lead a free, donation-based Community Meditation online, 19:30 to 20:00 Lisbon time, joined through the Temple of Sun WhatsApp circle. For a deeper practice, the 28 Days Meditation Challenge is a live Zoom cohort, 33 minutes of guidance each morning at 7:00 Lisbon time, currently €56. Details and how to join are on the meditation page .

### Do you only give treatments in Portugal, or do you travel?

Portugal is home base, but it is not a limit. I practise in Portugal and on retreat, and I travel further when called for. Write to me with where you are and what you are carrying, and I will answer personally with times and details. More on the treatments page .

### What is a Soul Alchemy Retreat?

Days lived together in nature, built from aromatherapy, yoga, meditation, ceremony and honest human company. People arrive tired and leave changed. The retreats page holds the full picture, including words from guests who have been.

### Do I need experience with yoga or meditation to join?

No. You need willingness, not experience. Every practice is guided and every body is welcome as it is. If you have doubts about whether a retreat is right for you, write to me and we will talk it through honestly.

### How long is a Soul Alchemy Retreat, and what does it include?

Six nights, seven days, together in a private Portuguese quinta. Each day weaves guided meditation, yoga and Qi-Gong, aromatherapy, massage, sound healing and soul-nourishing ritual, with plant-based meals and small circles throughout. The retreats page has a full sample day and words from past guests.

### Are there reviews from people who have been on a retreat?

Yes. Beyond the guest voices and videos on the retreats page itself, Temple of Sun retreats are listed on BookRetreats, where guests have left 29 five-star reviews and counting. Read them directly on BookRetreats .

### Can you make a formula just for me?

Yes. This is the deepest way to work with me on the oils. We talk, I learn what you are living through, and I compose a blend that belongs to you alone. The whole journey is described on Create Your Own Formula .

### Do you work with hotels, studios and other spaces?

I do. I create scent identities and wellness experiences for spaces, from yoga studios to hotels, and I hold workshops and group sessions for teams. My collaborations include Jivamukti Yoga centres, Vale de Moses and Quinta da Comporta. Start from the contact page with the business topic that fits.

### Can my shop or studio stock templeofsun blends?

Write to me through the contact page with a few words about your space and your people, and we will see if we are a match. I keep wholesale small and personal on purpose.

### Who is behind Temple of Sun?

I am Péter Frák, an aromatherapist and holistic practitioner from Hungary, living between Portugal and Hungary. templeofsun is my life's work: the blends, the treatments, the retreats and everything on this site come from my own hands. The short version of my path is on the bio page , the long one in my story .

### What is your training?

I am a member of the International Federation of Aromatherapists, hold a two-year aromatherapy diploma from Panarom in Budapest, and am certified in Ayurvedic and Marma-Abhyanga massage by the Mysore Ayurveda Academy in India. The full list of my credentials is on the bio page .

### What is your experience hosting retreats?

Before hosting my own, I spent four seasons as in-house therapist, co-facilitator and meditation guide at Vale de Moses, one of Europe's most loved yoga retreats in the Portuguese mountains, supporting more than fifty retreats and massaging hundreds of guests. Soul Alchemy Retreats grew directly out of that time. More in my story .

### My question is not here. What now?

Then ask me directly, it is the fastest way. Write through the contact page or on WhatsApp , and I will answer personally.
